correctness.rationale: The exact moment-ratio weighted shift yields a diagonal self-commutator. Triangular integral identities for \(g\) and its derivatives show the weights strictly increase. The fixed-width asymptotics of \(g\) imply \(q_n\sim(\gamma c m^3/4)n^{-\gamma-1}\). Exact telescoping gives trace \(m\). Two-sided tail-count bounds establish the ordered singular-value law and sharp Schatten/logarithmic endpoints, without presupposing that the raw eigenvalue sequence is monotone. Gamma and polygamma identities verify both example families; the 3294 finite numerical assertions are supplementary.

value.rationale: The theorem links radial moment curvature to sharp angular Toeplitz noncommutative spectral decay for a broad class of measures, with an exact cubic winding coefficient. It distinguishes the analytically natural disk and generalized Fock geometries by optimal critical exponents 1/3 and 1/2 and computes the borderline logarithmic spectral residue, beyond routine shift or index identities.
